tasks.label: Setup: Check Prerequisites
tasks.detail: Reports the status of every required dependency without installing anything
tasks.command: echo '-- Java --'; command -v java >/dev/null && java -version || echo '✗ Java not found'; echo; echo '-- Gradle wrapper --'; (cd backend && ./gradlew --version 2>/dev/null) | grep -q 'Gradle 9' && echo '✓ Gradle wrapper distribution present' || echo '✗ Gradle wrapper distribution not downloaded yet'; echo; echo '-- Node --'; command -v node >/dev/null && node -v || echo '✗ Node not found'; echo; echo '-- Docker --'; command -v docker >/dev/null && docker --version && (docker compose version || echo '✗ Docker Compose plugin not found') || echo '✗ Docker not found'

tasks.label: Setup: Install Java 21
tasks.detail: apt install openjdk-21-jdk (skips if already present)
tasks.command: if command -v java >/dev/null && java -version 2>&1 | grep -q '"21'; then echo '✓ Java 21 already installed'; else sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-21-jdk && echo '✓ Java 21 installed'; fi

tasks.label: Setup: Install Node 20+
tasks.detail: NodeSource setup script + apt install nodejs (skips if node >= 20 already present)
tasks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null && [ "$(node -v | sed 's/v//' | cut -d. -f1)" -ge 20 ]; then echo '✓ Node already >= 20'; else curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs && echo '✓ Node 20 installed'; fi

tasks.label: Setup: Install Gradle
tasks.detail: Downloads gradle-wrapper.jar (not committed to git) + bootstraps the pinned Gradle distribution (requires Java 21 first)
tasks.command: if [ -f gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar ]; then echo '✓ gradle-wrapper.jar already present'; else GRADLE_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'gradle-\K[0-9.]+(?=-bin\.zip)' gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties); curl -fsSL -o gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v${GRADLE_VERSION}/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" && echo "✓ downloaded gradle-wrapper.jar for Gradle ${GRADLE_VERSION}"; fi && ./gradlew --version

tasks.label: Setup: Check Docker
tasks.detail: Docker Engine & Compose plugin are installed on the host, not via this workspace — this only verifies presence
tasks.command: if command -v docker >/dev/null && docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '✓ Docker & Compose plugin found'; else echo '✗ Docker not found — install from https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu/'; fi

tasks.label: 🔧 Setup: Install All Dependencies
tasks.detail: Java 21 → Gradle → Node 20+ → check Docker (run once before first use)

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Start
tasks.detail: docker compose up -d  (Postgres :5433, Redis :6380, RabbitMQ :5672/:15672)
tasks.command: docker compose up -d && echo '✓ Infrastructure started'

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Stop
tasks.detail: docker compose down

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Logs
tasks.detail: Stream all container logs (Ctrl+C to stop)

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Status
tasks.detail: docker compose ps

tasks.label: Phone Proxy: Start
tasks.detail: socat relay: external :5173 → this workspace container's :5173, for native-app live reload over boc-dev.nj-server2.local
tasks.command: IP=$(docker inspect coder-N0t4R0b0t-bocollections --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}') && docker rm -f bocollections-phone-proxy >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name bocollections-phone-proxy -p 5173:5173 alpine/socat tcp-listen:5173,fork,reuseaddr tcp-connect:${IP}:5173 >/dev/null && echo "✓ Phone proxy relaying :5173 → ${IP}:5173"

tasks.label: Phone Proxy: Stop
tasks.detail: Removes the socat relay container
tasks.command: docker rm -f bocollections-phone-proxy && echo '✓ Phone proxy stopped'

tasks.label: Phone Proxy: Status
tasks.detail: docker ps for the socat relay container
